content.comment_body: Reset Tool for restoring [product_name] [version_no] devices to their original factory settings [product_name] [product_name_version_no] and basic devices from firmware [version_no] allow password-protected program transfers. If you no longer have the password, follow these steps for instructions and a download link to reset your [product_name] [version_no] basic device to its factory state: • Download the file__reset.zip(1 KB) • Save the file to your PC. • Extract the ZIP archive. • Copy the __reset.bm file to the root directory of your MicroSD card. • Disconnect power from the [product_name], insert the MicroSD card, and reconnect power. • After a few seconds, the [product_name] basic device will be reset to factory settings. • Remove the MicroSD card from the [product_name] basic device. Note: After resetting, all settings, configurations, and user programs will be deleted. Ensure a stable power supply within recommended tolerances throughout the reset process for the basic unit. For basic units with a display, manual reset to factory settings is possible directly on the [product_name].

The archive actually contains only a text file with a specific name. It's an undocumented option and might work with arbitrary text content (not tested): echo "Hello world!" > __reset.bm Although not an official tool, as long as it works as needed, users might refer to it as a tool, a universal reset method, or even the ultimate [product_name] [version_no] reset instrument.

analysis.insight_summary: The factory reset procedure for [product_name] [version_no] devices relies on placing a specially-named text file onto a microSD card, rather than using dedicated software. Some users find this solution to be undocumented and unclear, potentially expecting a more formal tool or clearer instructions. Important risks include loss of all user data and the requirement for a stable power supply during the reset.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a transparent, officially-documented, and safe method for factory resetting [product_name] [version_no] devices, ideally involving a clear dedicated tool and guidance, along with assurances regarding data safety and procedure reliability.
